headline: Google basically confirms the Pixel 11 is getting a price hike
summary: Google's VP hinted at an upcoming price increase for the Pixel 11. Rising RAM costs due to AI data centers are a key factor. The rumored price hike aligns with current market conditions.

headline: Synth historian Oli Freke will spend big on a good bicycle
summary: Oli Freke is a respected musician, journalist, and synthesizer historian. His work ranges from music theory to synth evolution through 1995. Despite his tech focus, he values investing in a high-quality bicycle.

headline: Teenage Engineering’s unique music machines are 30 percent off
summary: Teenage Engineering's distinctive 'grooveboxes' are currently available at 30% off. These devices combine synthesizers, loopers, and effects pedals for real-time music creation. They are celebrated for their unique design and functionality as both instruments and art.

headline: Warner Bros. is suing Amazon for poaching employees
summary: Warner Bros. Discovery has filed a lawsuit against Amazon. The suit alleges Amazon illegally poached employees, including a former senior VP. Warner Bros. accuses Amazon of a 'lawless employee shopping spree'.

headline: How Does Doctor Doom’s Avengers: Doomsday Costume Compare to the Comics? | Comic Con 2026
summary: A detailed analysis compares Doctor Doom's Avengers: Doomsday costume to its comic book origins. The article breaks down every detail of Robert Downey, Jr.'s new armor. The full reveal took place at Comic-Con 2026.

headline: George R.R. Martin Working on Dunk and Egg Book Four, A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms Showrunner Says
summary: George R.R. Martin is reportedly developing a fourth Dunk and Egg book. The news was shared by Ira Parker, showrunner for 'A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms'. This expands the lore of the 'A Song of Ice and Fire' universe.

headline: DC's Next Level Initiative Expands, Including a Must-Read Batman Comic | Comic Con 2026
summary: DC announced an expansion of its 'Next Level Initiative' at Comic-Con 2026. The new lineup includes a highly anticipated Batman comic series. This initiative promises an exciting slate of new DC books.

headline: Final Fantasy 7 Director Kept 'Open World Fatigue' in Mind as New Remake Chapter Promises 'Bigger' World Than Rebirth
summary: Final Fantasy 7 Revelation's director acknowledges player 'open world fatigue'. The new remake chapter promises a world 'bigger' than Rebirth. Developers aimed to provide ample guidance despite the expanded scale.

headline: Police investigate donations by Tice company to Reform UK
summary: Police are probing donations from Richard Tice's company, Britain Means Business. Two £250,000 donations were made to Reform UK before the 2024 general election. The investigation focuses on the legitimacy of these financial contributions.

headline: More than 250,000 flee wildfires in France and Spain
summary: Over a quarter-million people have evacuated due to intense wildfires in France and Spain. Spain's PM warns of 'complex hours' ahead as blazes continue. Authorities in France struggle to control fires near Bordeaux.

headline: Tourists tell BBC how their holiday turned into race to escape fires
summary: Families holidaying in France recount their terrifying wildfire evacuation experiences. Their planned vacations rapidly transformed into urgent escape missions. The BBC gathered testimonies from these affected tourists.

headline: Cairngorm residents say wildfire response 'too slow'
summary: Residents of Nethy Bridge in Cairngorm criticize the wildfire response. They claim emergency services were 'too slow' to act after evacuations. A major incident was declared in the area last Friday due to the fires.
